chunks: Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi al-Hafidh al-Baghdadi narrated to us, saying: He narrated to me Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Zayd ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them all), saying: He narrated to me my father, saying: He narrated to me Ali ibn Musa al-Rida, saying: He narrated to me my father Musa, saying: He narrated to me my brother Isma'il, from his father, from his forefathers, from al-Husayn ibn Ali, from Ali (peace be upon him), from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), from Gabriel, from God the Exalted, who said:

Whoever shows animosity to My friends has certainly come out to fight with Me in open combat, and whoever fights the People of the House of My Prophet, My punishment has descended upon him, and whoever takes others than them as allies, My wrath has descended upon him, and whoever honors others than them has indeed disturbed Me, and whoever disturbs Me, for him is the Fire.

key_terms.آذَانِي: He disturbed/me (from the root 'adha, meaning to cause trouble or disturbance)
key_terms.أَهْلَ بَيْتِ نَبِيِّي: The People of the House of My Prophet (Ahl al-Bayt)
key_terms.أَوْلِيَائِي: My friends (plural of wali, referring to the close associates of the Prophet/Ahl al-Bayt)
key_terms.بَارَزَنِي: He confronted/fought me openly (from baraza, meaning to come out into the open)

ai.seo_question: What are the divine consequences of showing animosity or fighting the Ahl al-Bayt according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith qudsi, transmitted through the Imams in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, emphasizes the centrality of *Walayah* (spiritual authority) of the Ahl al-Bayt as a criterion for divine acceptance. It delineates a hierarchy of spiritual states: animosity towards their *Awliya* constitutes direct war with God, while favoring non-Ahl al-Bayt figures incurs divine wrath and ultimately leads to the Fire. This underscores the Shia doctrine that loyalty to the Prophet's household is inseparable from loyalty to God.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-316 Muhammad ibn Umar al-Je’abi al-Hafidh al-Baghdadi narrated that Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn ibn Zayd ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) quoted on the authority of his father (a.s.), on the authority of Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.), on the authority of his father Musa (a.s.), on the authority of his brother Isma’il, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his forefathers, on the authority of Al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s.), on the authority of Ali (a.s.), on the authority of the Prophet (S), on the authority of Gabriel that the Sublime God said,

“Whoever treats my friends with animosity has undoubtedly come to fight with Me. My Punishment will overtake whoever fights with the Members of the Holy Household of My Prophet. My Wrath will overtake whoever chooses others (than the Members of the Holy Household) for his friends, and whoever disturbs them has indeed disturbed Me. The Fire is destined for whoever disturbs Me.”
